_comment: AIM deadlines, mirrored from the AIM December Ship Plan doc. Edit here, then run: python3 planning/sync_flux.py. Each id is permanent (it links the Flux task); change titles, dates and priorities freely. Priority: high = on the critical path to the Dec 10 launch; medium = needed for launch but not blocking; low = nice to have or cleanup.

deadlines.title: AIM: confirm Render auto-deploys
deadlines.notes: Done Oct 29: GitHub Action calls Render's deploy hook on every backend/ push and waits for /health to show the new commit.

deadlines.title: AIM: label first 50 frames in Label Studio
deadlines.notes: Done Oct 29: 80 frames (43 game 1, 37 game 2), quality check passed with small fixes.

deadlines.title: AIM: get stats sheets for both games + more film
deadlines.notes: Game 2 (Var vs DRIVE, 42.5 min) arrived Oct 26 and is pre-labeled. Coach is sending more film and the stats sheets this week; stats sheets are the answer key for testing the box score.

deadlines.title: AIM: label first 300 frames (enough for a first training run)
deadlines.notes: Done Nov 3: 312 usable frames (4 timeout frames left out via ml/exclude_frames.yaml, 3 skipped). Starts the first YOLOX training run.

deadlines.title: AIM: train YOLOX detector + GPU detection on Modal
deadlines.notes: v3 deployed Nov 4. On the unseen Menlo-Atherton gym (44 frames): ball 85%, players 91%, refs 88%, rims 100%. First real site upload Nov 7: 119-min game, playback copy 12 min, detection 21 min. Training v4 on all 767 frames of games 1 and 2.

deadlines.title: AIM: split teams by jersey color + read jersey numbers
deadlines.notes: Team split by jersey color works (k-means per game). Jersey number reading not started.

deadlines.title: AIM: finish labeling ~800 frames (2 games)
deadlines.notes: Done Nov 7: all 860 frames finished, 815 labeled and 45 skipped (timeouts, huddles, warmups). 19 wrong ball boxes removed after checks (mostly shoes). Games 1 and 2 train; Menlo-Atherton (44 frames) is the unseen test.

deadlines.title: AIM: event rules (shots, makes, 3PT, FT, rebounds, assists, turnovers)
AIM: confidence score on every call
deadlines.notes: So the review screen only shows the unsure ones.

deadlines.title: AIM: box score accuracy check vs scorebook
deadlines.notes: Gate: 80% of stats credited to the right player, team totals within 2. Miss -> bigger review queue, keep Dec 10.

deadlines.title: AIM: review screen (unsure calls queue + shortcuts)
deadlines.notes: Least confident first; accept, make/miss, change player, reject.

deadlines.title: AIM: box score + shot chart from real data
deadlines.notes: Confirmed events become Possession rows; replace mockData.ts.

deadlines.title: AIM: rosters + tag Valley vs opponent film
deadlines.notes: Opponent players get their own stats.

deadlines.title: AIM: upgrade Render to a paid instance before beta
deadlines.notes: Free tier sleeps after ~15 min idle (27 s cold start).

deadlines.title: AIM: one-page filming guide for beta coaches
deadlines.notes: One sideline camera that follows play.

deadlines.title: AIM: save every coach fix as training data
AIM: beta starts with Valley's staff + 1-2 coaches
deadlines.notes: Collect feedback weekly; measure review time per game (target 20 min).

deadlines.title: AIM: chatbot about any player (Claude)
deadlines.notes: Answers cite the box score and link the clips.

deadlines.title: AIM: chatbot test questions (95% match box score)
AIM: auto clip per confirmed event + team sharing
AIM: games-per-month cap per team
AIM: feature freeze (bug fixes only after this)
AIM: public beta launch
